title: TimescaleDB vs QuestDB: Which One Actually Scales? ⚡
fb_caption:
TimescaleDB vs QuestDB: Which Architecture Actually Scales in Production? ⚡

- Throughput: Analyzing raw ingestion and query speeds under heavy load.
- Latency: Comparing read and write performance for real-time applications.
- Consistency: Examining data integrity and transaction handling.
- Failure Modes: Understanding resilience and recovery mechanisms.
- Operational Overhead: Assessing ease of deployment, management, and scaling.

For production environments demanding robust scaling and feature-rich capabilities, TimescaleDB often offers a more mature and versatile solution, especially when integrated with PostgreSQL. QuestDB excels in raw speed for specific, high-throughput scenarios.
